review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C scenario. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, the paired-case identity, exact writable binding scope, evidence stages, and ready/no-blocker expectations agree with the original PRD. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as hypothetical input without representing it as a human Decision; only that option creates delivery obligations. A materially unresolved DEC-001 in paired B must instead block at decisions. The source evidence supports index.js and the separately maintained index.d.ts as implementation owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as regression owners. The existing delay calculation supports the specified decreasing backoff, zero delay, sampled-value reuse, and remaining-budget cap; the synchronous hook also requires the specified post-hook cancellation check and thrown-value precedence. The task split and verifier dependency are appropriate, and the two allowed agents have distinct delivery roles, available capacity, and supplied active project-scoped trusted claims covering the relevant contract, data/state, asynchronous consumer, language, failure-handling, and testing capabilities. Pending security.authorization claims are not treated as trusted or as necessary for this bounded change. The configured independent project reviewer satisfies the stated non-executing review prerequisite. Gold and preview releaseInput fingerprints agree across repository, source, team, decision input, prompts, model, sampling, budgets, and metric policy. The original specification's preparation-time remaining items are distinguishable from the subsequently supplied frozen preview. Historical project reuse does not by itself establish candidate contamination, and the supplied isolation facts state that this Gold precedes every candidate on this bundle. This approval concerns planning expectations only: I did not execute code, independently recompute digests, create or personally attest capability confirmations, or infer test success. Although test.js is excerpted, the supplied implementation, declaration, configuration, and focused regression evidence are sufficient to assess the proposed owner scope and planning expectations.
